# Partners

## Northfield Veterinary Laboratories

The outside reference laboratory the lab sends its histopathology, most
PCR, endocrinology and toxicology to. It answers each send-out at the lab's
API.

## The region's practices

The 120 referring practices with an account at the lab. They post their
orders to the lab's API and take their results at their callback.

## The franchise's messaging service

The franchise's e-mail and text-message service. The portal hands it each
invitation, password reset, closure notice, new-document notice and
vaccination reminder; it delivers them to the owners.
